description: Cancel a pending organization invitation before it is accepted. Use this for an invite sent in error; once someone has accepted, they are a member and this no longer applies. Find the id with list_invites. Returns { ok, inviteId }.

inviteId.description: The pending invitation's id, from list_invites.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: revoke_invite
